_about: 0.2.1 hotfix (2 Nov 2026; the owner's M01 report: a formation with the Brandt stalled at the mission's LockManeuvers): the player row maneuver_watchdog (on by default), after focus_only. Apply with specpatch.py to part2_data.js and docs/UI_SPEC.json (and the artifact's ui/spec, pinned set, after reading). Registry: modules/controller/src/impl/controller.cpp maneuver_watchdog; rule: core/game/maneuver_watch.h.

rows.label: Restart stalled maneuvers
rows.help: If your ship stalls during a formation, goto or dock (nearly stopped for 3 seconds, its goal more than 150 m away and not getting closer, and you are not steering), FLvibed starts the same maneuver again, up to 3 times, and logs what happened.
